articles.title: Gemini plans to distribute crypto prediction markets through Apex brokerages
articles.snippet: The proposed deal would make Gemini the exclusive venue for crypto event contracts offered through Apex’s FCM, expanding its prediction-market reach to brokerage clients.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Coinbase Puts Tokenized Stocks on Base
articles.snippet: These aren’t derivatives tracking stock prices; each token has a direct claim on a share including its rights.
